description: DIBCO FT V2: LOSS REBALANCING EXPERIMENT (PRIORITY 1 FIX). Strategy: (1) Resume from ANRI V1 BEST checkpoint (ckpt-120, PSNR 23.75 dB - BEFORE DIBCO fine-tuning), (2) CRITICAL FIX: Rebalance loss weights based on failure analysis (Perceptual 97%→60%, Pixel 1.8%→20%, Adv 1.1%→15%), (3) Increase gradient clip norm 1.0→5.0 for stability, (4) Reduce generator LR 1e-5→5e-6 for smoother convergence, (5) Target: Prevent thick edges & rough strokes from happening

experiment_metadata.fix_priority: PRIORITY 1: Loss Rebalancing (CRITICAL - Preemptive fix based on dibco_finetuning_from_anri_v1 failure analysis)

problem_analysis.issue_1_loss_imbalance: Perceptual loss dominated at 97% contribution (508.1 weighted value) despite only 10.0 weight
problem_analysis.issue_3_rough_strokes: Local variance 909 (vs ANRI V1: 158), Gradient CoV 5.08 (target <2.5)
problem_analysis.issue_4_gradient_instability: Generator gradient mean 556 (exploding), discriminator mean 14.5 (too weak)
problem_analysis.issue_5_performance_drop: PSNR dropped -3.23 dB from ANRI V1 (20.52 vs 23.75 dB)

pixel_loss_weight.rationale: Reduce weight because MSE value is very small (0.048), so even 200x weight only contributes 9.6

perceptual_loss_weight.rationale: CRITICAL: Perceptual loss value is ~50, so 10x weight = 500 (dominates everything). Reduce drastically to 1.0 for ~50 contribution

adv_loss_weight.rationale: Adversarial loss value ~3.9, needs higher weight for stronger discriminator feedback

rec_feat_loss_weight.rationale: Rec feat loss contribution is minimal (0.05), maintain for HTR feature preservation

expected_improvements.psnr: Target >24 dB (MAINTAIN from ANRI V1 23.75 dB, vs failed experiment 20.52 dB)
expected_improvements.ssim: Target >0.96 (MAINTAIN from ANRI V1 0.9670, vs failed experiment 0.9102)
expected_improvements.noise_variance: Target <500 (MAINTAIN from ANRI V1 391, vs failed experiment 8662)
expected_improvements.local_variance: Target <200 (MAINTAIN from ANRI V1 158, vs failed experiment 909)
expected_improvements.isolated_white_ratio: Target <9% (MAINTAIN from ANRI V1 8.25%, vs failed experiment 13.89%)
expected_improvements.avg_stroke_width: Target 3-5px (PRESERVE thin strokes, vs failed experiment 187px)

success_criteria.primary_psnr: PSNR ≥ 23.5 dB (maintain ANRI V1 performance on DIBCO dataset)
success_criteria.primary_smoothness: Local Variance < 250 (maintain smooth strokes from ANRI V1)
success_criteria.secondary_noise: Noise Variance < 1000 (prevent explosion seen in failed experiment)
success_criteria.stretch_goal: PSNR ≥ 25 dB + Local Variance < 200 + SSIM > 0.97 (exceed ANRI V1 on DIBCO)

training_strategy.resume_point: ANRI V1 best model (ckpt-120, PSNR 23.75 dB) - BEFORE DIBCO fine-tuning
training_strategy.rationale: Start from proven ANRI V1 checkpoint with CORRECTED loss weights to prevent degradation seen in dibco_finetuning_from_anri_v1 (which dropped to 20.52 dB)
training_strategy.epochs: 30 (allow full convergence with new loss balance)
training_strategy.patience: 15 (increased from 10, allow more exploration with new weights)

critical: Loss contribution breakdown (ensure balance: ~60% perc, ~20% pixel, ~15% adv)
PSNR trend (must MAINTAIN >23 dB from ANRI V1 baseline, NOT DROP like failed experiment)
Local variance (must MAINTAIN <200 from ANRI V1, NOT INCREASE to 909 like failed experiment)
Generator gradient norm (must stay <100, NOT EXPLODE to 556 like failed experiment)

abort_criteria.psnr_regression: If PSNR drops below 20.0 dB after 5 epochs, abort and investigate
abort_criteria.loss_explosion: If total loss > 1000 (vs expected ~72), abort and check implementation
abort_criteria.gradient_explosion: If generator gradient > 1000, abort and check LR/clip settings

next_steps_if_success.phase_2a: Add Total Variation loss (weight: 2.0) for explicit smoothness
next_steps_if_success.phase_2b: Add Edge-aware loss (weight: 10.0) for thin stroke preservation
next_steps_if_success.phase_3: Enhance discriminator (spectral norm, dropout 0.3, update ratio 2:1)

experiment_metadata.rollback_plan: If this experiment fails (PSNR <21 dB), revert to ANRI V1 checkpoint (thin_stroke_preservation_v1_finetuning/best_model/ckpt-120) and try progressive fine-tuning strategy instead
